verses.1: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.2: The son of man sets your faces toward the land of the giants. The king of those giants is Neshiy Rosh Meshachek and Tuvbal. And he is brought forth upon him.
verses.3: And you said, “Thus says Adonai Jehovah: I am your ruler and leader. You shall be his priests.”
verses.4: And I will restore you, and I will give you strength in your hearts. I will bring you out from there, along with all your horses and chariots. They will be like a great crowd, ready to defend against any attacks from enemies.
verses.5: Parsh Kush and Poot it all are shields and protections.
verses.6: Gomer and all her towns were destroyed by the sword of Togarmah. All her towns were conquered by many nations.
verses.7: Now, and always, you and all your followers will be under my protection. You will be their protector.
verses.8: From ancient times onward, in the years to come, a people will come and settle in this land. They will be from many nations who have been scattered from their homes. They will settle on the mountains of Israel, which have always been a place of destruction. But now, they will return and settle there in peace.
verses.9: And you will rise like a cloud, to cover the earth. You and all your tribes, along with many nations, will be covered by you.
verses.10: So said Adonai YHWH: On that day, things will be revealed in your heart. And you will think in a bad manner.
verses.11: And you said, “I will go up to the land of the mountains. The quiet ones will live there, all of them. They will live without heat or light, and their doors will be without locks.”
verses.12: To plow the fields and to restore them, so that your hands may be able to heal the wounds of those who have been oppressed. And to bring together a people from various nations, and to make them live in peace on this land.
verses.13: Shaba, Uddan, and all those who are greedy for wealth will say to you, “You have brought great wealth with you. You have brought your people along with you, so that they can take away gold and silver from their possessions.”
verses.14: So it was written that a son of man would be born. And you said to God, “Say this: ‘Lord Yahweh, on that day, in the house of my people, Israel, you will surely know.’”
verses.15: And you came from your place, from the land of Tzafon. You and many nations with you rode on horses. It was a large crowd, with many warriors among them.
verses.16: And you will come over my people, Israel, like clouds that cover the earth. In those days, your offerings will be brought to me as a sign of the nations’ knowledge of me in my holiness.
verses.17: As Adonai Yehovah has said: “You are the one I spoke about in ancient times, through the hands of Israel’s prophets who were sent during those times. They were sent to bring you upon them.”
verses.18: And it shall be on that day, when the storm comes upon the land of Israel. Then will Adonai Yehovah say, “Let my fire be kindled in my nostrils.”
verses.19: And in my anxiety, I said these words: “If not today, then surely there will be great noise and chaos on the land of Israel.”
verses.20: And the fish in the sea, and the birds in the sky, and all the creatures that live on the land were destroyed. All people who lived on the land also perished. The mountains were broken apart, and all the high places fell down. All living things on earth were destroyed.
verses.21: And I called upon him for all the nations. May the Lord Yahweh curse him! May he be cursed by his own brother.
verses.22: And I will judge him with words and bloodshed. Fire and ashes will cover him, along with his arms. And many nations will be destroyed by his actions.
verses.23: And I was exalted and sanctified, and I became known to many nations. They knew that I was Jehovah.
